title: Shape your Studio
question: Compare three ways to bring conversation, artwork, and the month together. Open a sketch at full size, then choose a starting point or describe what to combine.

options.label: Open Studio
options.thesis: A calm conversation above a broad, compact artwork grid.
options.viewport: A centered conversation opens into one searchable gallery. The right rail groups the month by day.
options.risk: The open canvas gives less space to a long conversation or a complicated order.

options.label: Collection Shelves
options.thesis: A gallery organized into recognizable bodies of work, with conversation above it.
options.viewport: A shallow chat sits above named gallery shelves. A small month calendar and agenda share the right rail.
options.risk: Collection groups need to stay useful when work belongs to several projects.

options.label: Batch Desk
options.thesis: Keep a visible order beside the conversation while selecting across a dense gallery.
options.viewport: The conversation and its current order share the top area. A dense gallery fills the center; the month stays at the right.
options.risk: More information is visible at once, so the first visit may feel busier.
